title: Vortex Ui
script:
‎local VortexUI = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://pastebin.com/raw/x6Wcsw4x"))()
‎
‎-- Create Window
‎local WindowInstance = VortexUI:CreateWindow("Vortex Panel", "Premium Version")
‎
‎-- Create Tabs
‎local MainTab = WindowInstance:CreateTab("Main")
‎local MovementsTab = WindowInstance:CreateTab("Movements")
‎local ExecutorTab = WindowInstance:CreateTab("Executor")
‎
‎-- Add Features
‎MainTab:AddLabel("Welcome to the Clean System Interface")
‎MainTab:AddLabel("Made By jo893921")
‎
‎local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
‎local LocalPlayer = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
‎local speedConnection
‎
‎MovementsTab:AddToggle("Toggle Speed", false, function(state)
‎    if state then
‎        speedConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
‎            if LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
‎                LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid.WalkSpeed = 60
‎            end
‎        end)
‎    else
‎        if speedConnection then speedConnection:Disconnect() end
‎        if LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
‎            LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid.WalkSpeed = 16
‎        end
‎    end
‎end)
‎
‎MovementsTab:AddButton("Super Jump", function()
‎    if LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
‎        LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid.JumpPower = 120
‎        LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
‎        task.wait(0.1)
‎        LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid.JumpPower = 50
‎    end
‎end)
‎
‎ExecutorTab:AddExecutor()
